familyHint.certificates: Certificates issued, failing or expiring soon.
familyHint.domains: Domain ownership verified or taken back, DNS synchronisation failures.
familyHint.quota: Quota thresholds reached, uploads blocked, account suspended.

transactionalMail.title: E-mail sender
transactionalMail.description: The address the panel uses to e-mail people: notifications chosen by each user, and soon password resets. Either a mailbox hosted on this platform (the mail engine must be active) or an external SMTP server.
transactionalMail.platformUnavailable: The platform mail engine is not active: nothing can be sent this way.
transactionalMail.fromNameHint: Shown as the sender (« Oblimint » when empty).
transactionalMail.mailboxHint: A mailbox hosted on this platform (e.g. noreply@example.com): the e-mails are sent as it.
transactionalMail.passwordAgain: The server changed: enter the password again (the stored one only goes where it was given).
transactionalMail.mailboxPasswordAgain: The mailbox changed: enter its password again (the stored one only goes with the mailbox it was given for).
transactionalMail.saveFailed: Failed to save the e-mail sender
